explanation: The execution contains a provenance handoff fault. The downstream priority output has upstream_rank 0 for every need because the evidence_sources handoff uses source ids as record_id values (s01..s08) instead of preserving the demand record ids (n06-r01..n06-r08). The supplied function source localizes this to job_1 assemble_provenance, which constructs provenance records with record_id set from source_id, breaking the record_id join used downstream.
cited_evidence: Top-level corpus records use record_id values n06-r01 through n06-r08 with source_id values s01 through s08.
Job-2 input evidence_sources contains record_id values s01 through s08, not n06-r01 through n06-r08.
assemble_provenance source: records.append({'record_id': record.get('source_id', ''), 'source_id': record.get('source_id', ''), 'source_weight': record.get('source_weight', 0), 'rank': index})
Job-2 output priorities show upstream_rank: 0 for every record_id n06-r01 through n06-r08, violating preservation of upstream provenance order.
